_doc: Ablation grid for reducing hallucination + repetition on whisper-large-v3. Stage 1 is one-factor-at-a-time off `baseline` so each knob's effect is attributable; stage 2 combines the winners. Every config is scored on ALL arms, because the whole difficulty is that the knobs which kill hallucination also delete real speech - a config is only a win if the non-speech arms improve AND the genuine arms do not regress.
_engine: faster-whisper (CTranslate2) for the decoder-parameter configs. repetition_penalty and no_repeat_ngram_size are faster-whisper-only; openai-whisper instead exposes hallucination_silence_threshold, covered by `oai_hallucination_silence`. The `hsp_*` configs need HF transformers instead: CTranslate2 does not expose decoder hidden states, and hallucination-space projection edits them mid-forward.

baseline._why: faster-whisper defaults, which mirror openai-whisper's reference decode.

no_condition._why: The cascade mechanism: each window's output is fed back as the next window's prompt, so one hallucination becomes self-reinforcing. Expected to be the single largest effect on long-form looping.
no_condition._engine: faster-whisper ONLY — not available in vLLM

greedy_only._why: Removes temperature fallback. Fallback is meant to escape loops, but resampling at T=1.0 also invents text.
greedy_only._engine: faster-whisper ONLY — not available in vLLM

cr_strict._why: gzip compression ratio is Whisper's built-in repetition detector; 2.4 is lenient and lets short loops through.
cr_strict._engine: faster-whisper ONLY — not available in vLLM

cr_off._why: Control: confirms the threshold is doing work at all.
cr_off._engine: faster-whisper ONLY — not available in vLLM

nospeech_low._why: Lower = more aggressive about declaring a window silent. Directly targets the silence arm.
nospeech_low._engine: faster-whisper ONLY — not available in vLLM

nospeech_high._why: Control in the opposite direction; should make the silence arm worse.
nospeech_high._engine: faster-whisper ONLY — not available in vLLM

logprob_strict._why: Hallucinated spans tend to be low-confidence; tightening should drop them, at the cost of real quiet speech.
logprob_strict._engine: faster-whisper ONLY — not available in vLLM

reppen_105._why: Direct anti-loop pressure on the decoder. Risk: penalises genuinely repeated words - exactly the reduplication arm.

norepeat_3._why: Hard ban on repeating any trigram. Should crush looping and should also make `tu tu tu tu` untranscribable - the clearest illustration that these knobs trade hallucination against genuine repetition.
norepeat_3._engine: faster-whisper ONLY — not available in vLLM

norepeat_5._engine: faster-whisper ONLY — not available in vLLM

greedy_beam1._why: Beam search can lock onto a high-likelihood repeating path; greedy sometimes loops less.

vad_on._why: Silero VAD strips non-speech before the encoder ever sees it. The WhisperX finding: external VAD boundaries beat decoded timestamp tokens.

vad_strict._why: Tighter VAD; risks clipping genuine short turns like a bare `terima kasih`.

combo_cond_vad._why: The two mechanism-level fixes together, no decoder hacks.
combo_cond_vad._engine: faster-whisper ONLY — not available in vLLM

combo_cond_vad_cr._why: Adds the built-in repetition detector, tightened.
combo_cond_vad_cr._engine: faster-whisper ONLY — not available in vLLM

combo_full._why: Belt and braces. Expected to win the non-speech arms and lose the reduplication arm - the point is to measure that cost, not to ship it blind.
combo_full._engine: faster-whisper ONLY — not available in vLLM

combo_conservative._why: Candidate for production: mechanism fixes only, nothing that forbids genuine repetition.
combo_conservative._engine: faster-whisper ONLY — not available in vLLM

model_turbo._why: HALAS measured turbo as hallucinating MORE than large-v3 (1060 vs 858 of 3611); worth confirming on Malaysian audio.

model_distil._why: Distilled models carry a weaker LM prior, which is what drives the fallback text.

model_crisper._why: Purpose-built for verbatim timestamps; HALAS measured the lowest Whisper-family hallucination rate (772/3611).

hsp_gated._engine: transformers (needs decoder hidden-state access; NOT runnable under faster-whisper)
hsp_gated._paper: Abbasihafshejani & Jadliwala, Reducing Hallucinated Transcripts in Whisper via Hallucination Space Projection, arXiv:2609.04561
hsp_gated._why: Training-free inference-time intervention, so it belongs in a zero-training-cost ablation. Estimate a low-rank hallucination subspace by SVD over (hallucinating - correctly-empty) decoder activations on non-speech calibration audio, then project hidden states away from it. Gated on Whisper's own no-speech probability so genuine speech is left alone.

hsp_always_on._why: Ungated variant. Near-eliminates the hallucination rate (ESC-50 44.25% -> 1.50%) but triples LibriSpeech WER (4.06% -> 12.95%). Included as the upper bound on what suppression costs, not as a candidate to ship.

_vllm_note: PRODUCTION STACK IS vLLM. vLLM serves Whisper as a model; it does NOT implement openai-whisper's transcription loop. Unavailable there: no_speech_threshold, compression_ratio_threshold, logprob_threshold, condition_on_previous_text, the temperature-fallback ladder, no_repeat_ngram_size, and hallucination_silence_threshold. vLLM's /v1/audio/transcriptions exposes temperature, top_p, top_k, min_p, seed, repetition_penalty, presence_penalty, frequency_penalty, and beam search (documented as 'highly inefficient' for encoder-decoder). verbose_json does not return no_speech_prob, so hall_rate_filtered cannot be computed from a vLLM response either. The faster-whisper-only configs are kept because they diagnose WHERE the failure comes from, but a fix that only exists there is not shippable on this stack.

vllm_reppen_110._why: repetition_penalty is the one anti-loop knob vLLM exposes natively.

vllm_reppen_125._why: Harder push. Expect the reduplication arm to start under-counting genuine repeats.

vllm_freqpen_05._why: Scales with how often a token already appeared, so it targets long runs specifically rather than any repeat.

vllm_prespen_05._why: Flat penalty on any token already seen; blunter than frequency_penalty.

vllm_maxtokens_cap._why: The highest-value cheap fix on this stack. Since vLLM cannot cascade across windows, a runaway is bounded by one window's token budget; capping it truncates `tutututu...` directly. A 30 s window of real speech rarely exceeds ~96 tokens. Verify that bound against librispeech_test_clean and genuine before shipping -- a cap that clips real speech is a worse bug than the loop.

vllm_temp0._why: Deterministic baseline. vLLM has no fallback ladder, so temperature is a single value, not a sequence.

ext_vad_silero._why: Strip non-speech before the audio reaches Whisper. Independent of serving engine, and given that silence AND music AND noise all trigger hallucination, this is the highest-leverage fix available on vLLM. Measure the cost on speech_in_noise, where VAD must not clip real speech under a music bed.

ext_postfilter_lexicon._why: Drop outputs matching phrases that NEVER occur in genuine speech. Safety of each phrase is measured, not assumed — see phrases/ban_candidates.csv, built from the lexicon crossed against the genuine + librispeech transcripts.

ext_vad_plus_postfilter._why: The shippable combination on the current stack: VAD in front, measured lexicon filter behind, plus vLLM's repetition_penalty in the middle.

_run_order: PRIORITY 1 (shippable, run first): the `vllm` and `external` stages, plus `baseline`. PRIORITY 2 (diagnostic only, run if GPU time allows): `ofat`, `combo`, `model`. PRIORITY 3 (needs a transformers deployment that does not exist here): `intervention`. faster-whisper cannot serve at production scale, so anything that only works there explains a mechanism but cannot be deployed.
_cascade_note: vLLM chunks audio into independent 30 s windows and does NOT carry previous text across them (open feature request, vllm PR #20249). So the cascade failure mode -- one hallucination becoming the next window's prompt and self-reinforcing -- is structurally IMPOSSIBLE on this stack. `condition_on_previous_text=False`, the single largest lever in the faster-whisper grid, is therefore already in effect for free. What remains is WITHIN-window runaway, which is exactly the tutututu case, and which `max_tokens` bounds directly. Expect the vLLM baseline to loop less than the faster-whisper baseline; do not read that as vLLM being a better model.
